The Singing Wires (sing)
events.note: The pole itself (painted). Act 1: 'sing', and the Ghost learns Ghostly Touch.

parameters: Gully lesson: 'sing' (Lasa, Act 1). Self Switch B = done.
The wires sing! People talk through them. Far away.
The wires sang back! ...No, that was just me.
You can drink that out of things. Don't make a face.

events.name: The Dead Tree (tree)
events.note: The tree itself (painted). Act 1: 'tree', and the Ghost learns Crushing Touch.

parameters: Gully lesson: 'tree' (Lasa, Act 1). Self Switch B = done.
A tree. A dead one. Everything here is a bit dead.
It's already dead. You can't scare it more.
That tree's hand looks heavy. Grab them like that.
Slow things are easy to rob.

events.name: Ravens in the Dead Tree (bird)
events.note: A raven that doesn't fight (the ravens that do are a wanderer nearby). Act 1: 'bird'.

parameters: Gully lesson: 'bird' (Lasa, Act 1). Self Switch B = done.
Birds! \C[6]They\C[0] can see you. Birds see everything.
They're laughing at you. Birds do that.

events.name: The Gusty Saddle (wind)
events.note: The gap at the levee's west end. Act 1: 'wind', and the Ghost learns Cutting Touch.

parameters: Gully lesson: 'wind' (Lasa, Act 1). Self Switch B = done.
Wind! You can't see it either. You're the same!
Ha! Now you ARE the wind.
You push like the wind does.
Push their heads around so they can't aim!

events.name: The Spring (water)
events.note: Act 1: 'water', and the Ghost learns Chilling Touch.

parameters: Gully lesson: 'water' (Lasa, Act 1). Self Switch B = done.
Water! You know water. You saw your face in it.
That's baby talk. You're a big ghost.
It's not scared. It just keeps going.
Then I throw a rock, and they go all soggy.
